title: Quality of life improving app
body: With ADHD I’m never able to get into or follow routines. But I’m 8 days in and have actually got a morning routine streak for the full 8 days. I’m feeling better in the mornings than I have in a long time. I’m looking forward to expanding to even more routines to get myself better organised. This is definitely a quality of life improving app that I’ll be keeping for a long time
author: Critical-creator

title: No sound
body: No matter what I did I couldn’t get the sound at the end of each timer to work. I went through all my settings. Scrolled Reddit for answers. The whole app is so good but effectively useless if the timer doesn’t sound to alert you time is up.
author: Thatch08

title: Love it
body: I was looking for a free routine app and finally found one it s nice and works I went from clumsy and not doing what I should be to happy and healthy thank you
author: Ath3na15714

title: Very well done, but missing some things
body: I love this app, however this would easily get 5 stars if it had a “reminders” option in the checklist, or be able to put some things to pop up on a due date for future appointments, etc. Also an option to repeat a routine every 6 weeks (it only goes up to 5).
author: TheMightyOaf

title: Great Concept, Just a Few Bugs
body: Brilliant idea, and very handy. The limitation of only two routines on the free version is frustrating albeit understandable. My main concern is the spamming notifications at the start time of routines. My first day i had over 40 notifications before realising what was causing it. Adjusting the settings in the app has not fixed this, as the notifications still appear repeatedly. The best solve i’ve found is to turn off the app’s notifications from device settings. This is not ideal as the notifications are still valuable, just in smaller quantities. One moderate issue in an otherwise good app
author: Crazybigpippin

title: Stop doing review pop up’s
body: App is fine but every 10 seconds I get a review pop up even though I paid for it.
author: kcgistaken

title: Stellar stuff- highly recommend
body: This app has single-handedly improved my quality of life. I love how it’s so simple and straightforward to use, but at the same time has not fallen short of ensuring it has all the necessary components required for it to be effective. It helps me get and stay on track in the morning and evenings, and incorporate habits I’ve been wanting to try/build. I cannot recommend it enough, and was almost tempted to gatekeep it so it doesn’t get too popular and then inevitably over-monetised/advertisement laden, but the team have done a stellar job and they deserve all the compliments and appreciation. Amazing.
author: jas__reviews
